.qc-cache/coldwater-editor-2026-10-02-r1/task/tests/{scoring.toml,test.sh,tools/score.py} and all five gates/scored judge.toml and prompt.md files
evidence: The public contract requires exact fields to be saved and read on a fresh page, while explicitly leaving routes and implementation choices to the builder (environment/instructions/behaviour.md:9; integration.md:5; policy.md:3-5). The hard constraints gate adds 'Observe a successful application write response containing its exact title, filename and source' (tests/gates/constraints/judge.toml:32). A valid Save that returns HTTP 204 and then serves the exact durable record to an independent clean context fails that extra transport-shape demand. Constraints uses all_pass (judge.toml:15); scoring.toml:2-11 and tools/score.py:41-48 zero the entire weighted reward when any gate fails, so this one hidden gate condition collapses the score even for an otherwise complete app. Conditional on passing gates, the rubric does have graded structure: 23 independently weighted functional criteria (total weight 30.5), two polish criteria and three five-point visual criteria under weighted_mean; thus the defect is the gate cliff, not absence of scored rows. No raw-evidence-index.json or runtime-evidence.json was present in this run at review time, and no hash-bound weak-app/full-judge observations were available to establish empirical score spread.
counterexample: Conforming alternative: a custom editor implements all requested editing, preview and revision behavior; its Save endpoint commits exact title, filename and source and returns 204 No Content; a separate clean browser context loads and reloads the same saved fields from the server. It satisfies the public persistence contract but fails the gate's required response body and receives reward 0. Plausible weaker app: it implements only a basic custom editing surface, authored JavaScript Run and server-backed Save with an echo response; it passes all three gate criteria while lacking multi-caret editing, formatting, revision conflict safety and other scored features, so it can earn partial reward. This is a source-grounded counterexample, not an observed provider score.
suggested_fix: In cw_shared_saved_record, accept any successful Save response coupled with independent clean-context readback and reload of the exact durable fields; remove the requirement that the write response itself echo them. Keep the public persistence outcome and shared scoring policy unchanged. Then measure reward spread with hash-bound full judge runs on several partial-quality apps and the conforming alternative.
